Q5738.reason: A mixed goods-and-services contract is governed by the UCC unless its predominant purpose is the service portion, so Connie wins under the UCC unless the service agreement predominates.

Q5278.reason: Burglary requires intent to commit a felony at entry, and he entered only to crash the party and formed the intent to steal the baseball only after he was inside.

Q8324.reason: Agitated, coercive medication-seeking fits a hypodopaminergic withdrawal or craving state with less dopamine in the synaptic cleft, not dopamine-cell death.
